adults.prompt: Redraw ONLY the running animation of the two reference characters as an animation artist. Transparent sprite sheet exactly FOUR columns FOUR rows (16 frames), square equal cells. Same identities and clothing. First character in first 8 cells; second in last 8. All movement LEFT. Crucial correction: first FOUR frames must have the FACE in left-facing PROFILE, nose pointing LEFT, eyes looking LEFT, NOT over the shoulder. Last four frames turn head toward viewer/right to check behind. Bodies always run left. One full 8-pose running cycle per character: 0 near boot far forward LEFT heel down, far boot back RIGHT; 1 body lowers, near knee flexes, far boot under hips; 2 near boot pushes BACK on RIGHT with toes down, FAR KNEE drives UP LEFT; 3 airborne, FAR boot extends LEFT and NEAR boot curled behind RIGHT; 4 FAR boot contacts LEFT, NEAR knee below hips; 5 body lowers on FAR leg, NEAR knee drives up LEFT; 6 FAR boot pushes BACK RIGHT, NEAR knee high LEFT; 7 airborne with NEAR boot extended LEFT then loop. The NEAR and FAR legs MUST exchange front/back positions, full scissor stride, different visible leg silhouettes in all consecutive poses, not the same pose wiggling. Exaggerated big boots and clear tucked passing poses, skirt lifts just enough to reveal both boots in distinct phases. Shoulder and hand counter-swing. Identical character size, no scale changes. No candy, actions, floor, speed lines, labels, extra rows or text. Crisp painted cartoon with dark contours.
